SELECT s.id, s.class_id, s.teacher_id, s.classroom_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM class_schedule s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY s.start_time

SELECT s.id, s.class_id, s.teacher_id, s.classroom_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.status, u.real_name AS teacher_name FROM class_schedule s JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.teacher_id WHERE s.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND s.status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'COMPLETED') ORDER BY s.start_time

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_schedule s JOIN class_student cs ON cs.class_id = s.class_id AND cs.status = 'ENROLLED' LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.schedule_id = s.id AND a.student_id = cs.student_id WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.status = 'COMPLETED' AND a.id IS NULL
